protocol.unit: 20 separately executed artifact-producing checkpoints from 10 session families; checkpoints within a family are correlated
protocol.answer_model: same frozen route and version in both arms; default existing Sol gateway route
protocol.cache_policy: Reuse compiled shared prefixes by content and policy hashes; materialize a closed snapshot at each cutoff. Never retrieve later family turns into an earlier task.
protocol.history_policy: All nonempty original messages strictly before cutoff. Current original user request is common live input. Later original messages are withheld.
protocol.within_task_policy: Each arm develops its own live tool/action history; memory ingests every new action, observation and final reply, with the same current-turn working window in both arms.
protocol.qwen_input_policy: hierarchical summaries only; raw summarization follows the existing authorized path
protocol.policy: Current public cap-8, v7-derived engineering actor instructions; lightweight hints are not silently enabled
protocol.first_pilot: E01 and R05 only; verify lifecycle and grading before running remaining development or validation tasks
protocol.full_context_overflow: Mark unsupported, never truncate or silently summarize; exclude no case silently.
protocol.latency: Record cold ingest/reopen separately; compare warm task time, time to first token, per-action latency, tokens and actual provider usage.
protocol.engineering_scoring: Required artifacts plus executed behavioral checks where specified, then source-grounded semantic rubric; failure must identify a requirement and evidence.
protocol.research_scoring: Source-supported claim/assumption separation, arithmetic consistency, study design and stated limitations. Citation validation is necessary but not scientific truth validation.
protocol.rubric_score: Each criterion 0 unmet / 1 partial / 2 met; ambiguous or invalid judgments unresolved. Report domain and case results, not only pooled averages.
protocol.task_success: All required artifacts, critical behavioral checks and criteria met; unresolved is separate from failure.
protocol.grading: Blind A/B, identical sources, shuffled stable arm order; adjudicate disagreements and a sample of passes. Historical assistant text is not a gold answer.
protocol.failure_attribution: For every miss inspect requirement support in source, selected routes, exact hydrated packet and produced artifact; classify delivery gap, reader misuse, implementation error, ambiguity or grader defect.
protocol.reporting: Report paired wins/ties/losses, task success, criterion scores, unresolved cases and artifact checks by domain and session family. Any uncertainty resampling clusters by family, not 20 independent tasks.
protocol.cost_budget: No provider work during creation. Seal an explicit ingest, actor and grading call/token budget before the two-case pilot.
protocol.evaluation_scope: Offline engineering components/design and evidence-grounded research synthesis/planning; not live literature search, missing-repository reconstruction or million-token stress certification.
